description: This Java class 'ImportProductHelper' provides utility methods for preparing product and inventory data maps and checking the existence of a product in the database within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to create product and inventory item records with specified attributes and to verify if a product ID already exists in the database.

classes.name: ImportProductHelper
classes.description: A utility class for preparing product and inventory data and verifying product existence in the database in OFBiz.

methods.name: prepareProduct
methods.description: Creates a map representing a product with given productId, setting default values for product type, internal name, and virtual/variant flags.

methods.name: prepareInventoryItem
methods.description: Creates a map representing an inventory item with specified productId, quantity, and inventory item ID, setting default values for inventory item type and owner/facility IDs.

methods.name: checkProductExists
methods.description: Checks whether a product with the specified productId exists in the database using the delegator; returns true if exists, false otherwise.
